label: Tanec · Břišní minutový s hudbou (LTX)
label_en: Dance · Belly, one minute with music (LTX)
desc: Rychlejší a ostřejší varianta minutového břišního tance s jednou souvislou skladbou. Podoba tváře se mezi střihy vlní — na střihu se vrací k fotce, uvnitř klipu ujíždí.
desc_en: The faster, sharper take on the one-minute belly dance with one continuous piece of music. The facial likeness pulses — it returns to the photo at each cut and drifts within a clip.
soundtrack: the dancer performs a belly dance, hips swaying to the rhythm. Middle-eastern percussion music with a steady hypnotic drum rhythm and a melodic flute line.
style_tail: , static camera, natural room lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed
negative: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted

beats.prompt: the dancer lifts both arms slowly overhead as one wave travels up through their torso, and ends with arms high
the dancer lowers their arms to shoulder height with a slow sway of the hips, and ends with arms out to the sides
the dancer begins a fast isolated hip shimmy, then lets it fade and ends with hips still
the dancer drops one hip sharply to the side twice, accenting the beat, and ends with weight on that hip
the dancer performs one slow chest circle while keeping their hips still, and ends centered
the dancer turns slowly on the spot, arms flowing like a veil around their shoulders, and ends facing the camera
the dancer traces a figure eight with their hips, hands framing their face, and ends with hands at their collarbone
the dancer shimmies again for a short burst with arms overhead, then stops with hips still
one slow undulation travels down their torso from chest to hips, and ends with their weight settled
the dancer turns slowly once more, gathering an imaginary silk veil around their shoulders, and ends facing the camera
the dancer lowers their arms slowly and crosses their hands over their heart, and holds
the dancer bows their head slightly, then lifts it with a soft smile at the camera, and ends still
